chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Ali ibn al-Hussein al-Sa'ed Abady quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Barqy, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of Aban, on the authority of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
There are twelve hours in the night and twelve hours in the day, and the best times of the night and day are the times of prayer.

Then he (peace be upon him) said: When the sun sets, the gates of heaven open, the winds blow, and Allah, the Exalted, looks upon His creation. And I love that a good deed of mine ascends to the heavens at that time.
Then he said: Adhere to supplication after the prayers, for it is answered.
ai.seo_question: What are the best times for prayer and supplication according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to emphasize the cosmic significance of the twelve-hour division of day and night, linking the temporal structure of creation to spiritual opportunity. The Imam highlights sunset (Zawal) as a moment of divine attention and cosmic activity, encouraging believers to capitalize on this auspicious time for ascending good deeds. He concludes with the practical directive to perform supplication (Dua) immediately after obligatory prayers, noting their high likelihood of acceptance.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 12-66 Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn al-Hussein al-Sa’ed Abady quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Barqy, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of Aban that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said,
“There are twelve hours in each day and twelve hours in each night. The best times of day and night are the times to pray.”

Then he (MGB) added, “The gates to the heavens open up every morning when the sun rises. The wind starts to blow and the Honorable the Exalted God looks upon His creatures. I like a good deed of mine to go up to the heavens at that time.”
He (MGB) then added, “I advise you to say supplications after you pray as they will be fulfilled.”
